items.title: Mourinho
items.synopsis: Sports documentary series tracing the rise of José Mourinho, one of football's most iconic and decorated managers — from translator to two-time Champions League winner.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.synopsis: New hour of stand-up from Rory Scovel, riffing on everyday absurdities with his trademark loose, improvisational style.

items.title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish
items.synopsis: Season 3 of the animated preschool series — 10 new episodes of whimsical Seussian adventures, landing right before the back-to-school rush.

items.title: The Ribbon Hero
items.synopsis: Japanese animated feature based on Princess Knight, the pioneering manga by Osamu Tezuka — the 'Godfather of Manga.' Gorgeous animation honoring the legendary source material.

items.title: A Child of My Own
items.synopsis: After suffering multiple miscarriages, a recently married woman fabricates a pregnancy to escape societal shame — a charade that erupts into a massive national media scandal. Directed by Oscar-nominated Maite Alberdi.

items.title: My Brilliant Career
items.synopsis: Australian period drama. Modern, rebellious Sybylla dreams only of writing — choosing a career over a safe marriage is easy, until she falls in love unexpectedly.

items.title: This, That and Everything in Between
items.synopsis: Filipino drama movie weaving intersecting everyday stories.

items.title: Tires
items.synopsis: Season 3 of Shane Gillis's hit workplace comedy — back to the hilarious, mundane, and often raunchy antics of the Valley Forge Automotive Center crew.

items.title: MLB Field of Dreams: Phillies vs. Twins
items.synopsis: Netflix live event — Major League Baseball's Field of Dreams game between the Philadelphia Phillies and Minnesota Twins, streaming live from Iowa.

items.title: The Last House
items.synopsis: Genre-bending sci-fi horror thriller directed by Louis Leterrier. A family is mysteriously sealed inside their home and must band together to survive dwindling resources and the ominous force keeping them trapped.

items.title: Alley Cats
items.synopsis: Adult animated comedy from the mind of Ricky Gervais — a gang of foul-mouthed feral British cats cause havoc and seek companionship while musing on the meaning of life in a brutal human world.

items.title: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
items.synopsis: Military drama set during the 1999 Kargil War, following the Indian Air Force's Golden Arrows Squadron through a high-stakes aerial campaign — courage, sacrifice, and impossible choices at extreme altitude.

items.title: Our Sticky Love
items.synopsis: South Korean romantic comedy. A prosecutor with severe amnesia after a mob run-in is 'rescued' by a former boxing prodigy turned gang member, who claims to be her boyfriend to protect her — he knows her as his childhood first love.

items.title: Death Inc.
items.synopsis: Season 4 — the final season of the rescued Spanish comedy drama.

items.title: My Life with the Walter Boys
items.synopsis: Season 3 of the hit teen romantic drama. In the fallout from George being rushed to the hospital, Alex turns to a new rodeo team, Cole explores racing, and Jackie pours her heart into a community space until a childhood friend arrives from New York.

items.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
items.synopsis: Part 2 of the sweeping Spanish-language adaptation of Gabriel García Márquez's masterpiece — the grand finale wrapping up the generations-spanning magical-realism saga of the Buendía family in Macondo.

items.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
items.synopsis: Stand aside, Super Size Me — comedian Mo Gilligan runs a 28-day experiment eating absolutely nothing but fried chicken.

items.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
items.synopsis: Gripping Swedish documentary special diving into one of the country's most infamous corporate financial crimes and its shocking aftermath.

items.title: Let's Marry Harry
items.synopsis: New reality dating series — suitors compete for Harry's heart.
Season 3 of the hit Polish period comedy — a bumbling nobleman schemes to stay relevant in 17th-century Poland.

items.title: Badly in Love
items.synopsis: Season 2 of the Japanese reality dating show — singles navigate messy, unfiltered romance.

items.title: Sesame Street: Storm on the Street
items.synopsis: 30-minute kids' special — a storm hits Sesame Street, with Post Malone guest starring.

items.title: Forbidden Woman
items.synopsis: Colombian telenovela (La mujer prohibida) built around a politician's wife and a famous singer — passion, political intrigue, corruption, and family secrets.

items.title: Final Project
items.synopsis: Mexican teen suspense drama (Proyecto Final) blending cyberbullying, school secrets, and an enemies-to-lovers thread between Tamara and Xavi.

items.title: Wrath
items.synopsis: Brazilian crime series — six episodes of escalating vengeance and underworld fallout.

items.title: Bloody Smart
items.synopsis: Taiwanese thriller series — a brilliant mind pulled into a dangerous game of deception.

items.title: 72 Hours
items.synopsis: Kevin Hart plays Joe, a 40-year-old ad executive whose career is falling apart. Accidentally added to a stranger's bachelor-party group text, he crashes the three-day Miami trip to rebuild his confidence and his life.

items.title: The Truthers
items.synopsis: Spanish drama digging into conspiracy, belief, and the cost of chasing hidden truths.

items.title: Musafir Cafe
items.synopsis: Eight-episode Indian romantic drama set across Bhopal and Mussoorie — three strangers' lives intertwine through chance encounters, exploring love, grief, and identity.

items.title: The Debt Collector
items.synopsis: Gritty Thai action-thriller — a terminally ill former debt collector, fresh out of prison, is pulled back into the criminal world for one final fight against an illegal lending network.

items.title: Love in Slow Motion
items.synopsis: Arabic romantic comedy — love that unfolds one careful step at a time.

items.title: Ransom Canyon
items.synopsis: Season 2, set six months later — rancher Staten Kirkland fights to reclaim his family's Double K Ranch, Quinn O'Grady returns from New York, and Patricia Clarkson joins as Quinn's mother.

items.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
items.synopsis: Brazilian psychological thriller inspired by the real Elize Matsunaga case — a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and is consumed by betrayal, leading up to the 2012 murder that shocked Brazil.

items.title: My Daughter's Father
items.synopsis: Mexican medical drama — a doctor desperately searches for a kidney donor for her critically ill daughter.

items.title: Elite Force
items.synopsis: French action-thriller from the creators of Ganglands. A senior GIGN commander is forced back into active command when stolen military-grade explosives target his unit — while protecting his godson, a new recruit.

items.title: WWE: Unreal
items.synopsis: Season 3 goes inside WWE's creative process on the road to WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas — John Cena's retirement tour, AJ Lee's long-awaited return, and the rise of Trick Williams, Oba Femi, and Bron Breakker.
